scenes.title: The New Waiter
scenes.summary: Max starts working as a waiter in the dining room and tries to memorize a table's complicated dinner order without writing it down.

scenes.title: Equipment for the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Nagiyev brings molecular-cuisine equipment into the kitchen and orders Chef Barinov to hire a specialist immediately.

scenes.title: A Fine for Talking
scenes.summary: Vika fines Max three thousand rubles and then five thousand when he asks her to a cafe, while Nastya thinks she feels the baby kicking.

scenes.title: The Horseback Ride
scenes.summary: Nastya admits to Kostya that she still hasn't told her father about the baby and dodges her dad's phone call about horseback riding.

scenes.title: Socks in the Centrifuge
scenes.summary: Nagiyev catches Senya drying socks in the laboratory centrifuge and confronts Chef Barinov over sabotaging the interviews for a molecular chef.

scenes.title: A Call from London
scenes.summary: Barinov rejects candidates on ridiculous grounds, Nagiyev makes a call to hire a molecular chef himself, and Vika gets an offer from Nikolai.

scenes.title: Meet Katya
scenes.summary: Max tallies his failed attempts to win Vika over, Kostya mentions her mysterious phone call, and Nagiyev introduces Katya Semyonova.

scenes.title: The Strict Father
scenes.summary: Barinov tries to refuse having a woman in his kitchen, Nagiyev overrules him, and Nastya tells Kostya that her strict father might kill him.

scenes.title: An Unexpected Guest
scenes.summary: Nastya's father arrives at the restaurant unannounced for business talks, Nastya refuses to serve meat-eaters, and Vika receives a bouquet.

scenes.title: Katya's Presentation
scenes.summary: Vika agrees to meet Nikolai after work, and in the kitchen Katya presents restructured molecular tomato soup to Chef Barinov and the team.

scenes.title: Chocolate Wind
scenes.summary: Nagiyev and Barinov taste the molecular tomato soup and frozen chocolate wind, and Nagiyev reveals that the molecular menu is already approved.

scenes.title: The Waiters' Conspiracy
scenes.summary: Barinov bribes the waiters to steer customers away from the molecular menu, and Max and the waitstaff talk guests into ordering classic dishes instead.

scenes.title: Work for Everyone
scenes.summary: With zero molecular orders coming in, Barinov tells Katya she cannot stand idle and assigns her mundane kitchen tasks.

scenes.title: Lunch Break
scenes.summary: Stung by the cooks' teasing, Max persuades Nastya's father and his business partners to order four portions of molecular cuisine.

scenes.title: Haute Cuisine
scenes.summary: Max serves Katya's molecular dishes in the dining room, sparking a wave of molecular orders from other tables.

scenes.title: A Glass of Champagne
scenes.summary: Nastya's father praises the meal and prepares to sign the contract, but Max accidentally sprays champagne over him and the documents.

scenes.title: Unexpected News
scenes.summary: Nastya's father discovers his partners' deception, and Kostya announces to him that Nastya is pregnant and they are getting married.

scenes.title: Father and Daughter
scenes.summary: Max jealously watches Vika leave for her evening meeting, and Barinov argues with his daughter Katya about working in his kitchen.

scenes.title: A Business Meeting
scenes.summary: Barinov orders Katya and Lyova to keep their family connection secret in the kitchen, while Vika realizes Nikolai's boat meeting is actually a date.

scenes.title: A Real Date
scenes.summary: Max jumps off a bridge into the river to interrupt Vika's boat date with Nikolai and wins a quiet moment with her.
